name: lightback
description: Framework-agnostic in-app feedback capture with element selection, screenshots and AI-ready payloads

paragraphs: Framework-agnostic in-app feedback capture. Users pick the elements they are talking about, write a note, optionally attach a screenshot, and submit. The payload carries the context a developer or a model needs: component chain for each selected element, console output, errors, network requests, breadcrumbs, environment and whatever app context you attach. Nothing leaves the browser until the user sends; sending shows a cancel window, and the full preview is one click away.
